$comment: Bundle budgets for the landing (docs/landing-3d/SPEC.md §9.2), read by budgets.mjs against a built dist/.
Sizes are gzip (level 9) in kB as Vite prints them (1 kB = 1000 bytes).

pieces: what is measured. A file is a path or a glob relative to dist/; '@entry-js' and '@entry-css' are the module script and the stylesheet that dist/index.html links; '@inline:<id>' is the text of the element with that id in dist/index.html. A piece marked optional may be absent from a build (it measures 0 then): MathText goes in M3, ParticleField in M4, the stage chunk arrives in M4.

budgets: each sums pieces (formula, 'a + b') or lists its own files, and applies from the milestone in 'from' (to the one in 'until', if any). LX_STAGE says which milestone the build is at; with LX_ENFORCE=1, an over budget that applies at LX_STAGE fails the run. Budgets that apply later are measured and shown, never enforced.

html.what: dist/index.html: the static first frame, the reading version, the inline critical CSS, the boot script and the JSON-LD

entry.what: the entry chunk (the module script in dist/index.html)

entryCss.what: the entry stylesheet (the stylesheet link in dist/index.html)

landingCss.what: the CSS the landing chunk imports

particleField.what: today's 3D code, the hero's field (retired in M4)

stage.what: the stage code and shaders (from M4, SPEC §2.7: import('./stage/Stage'))

budgets.name: html
budgets.spec: §9.2 HTML (gzip), including the static first frame, the reading version, inline critical CSS, the boot script and JSON-LD

budgets.name: jsBeforeTakeover
budgets.spec: §9.2 JS before takeover (gzip): entry + landing shell, <= 200 KB until M11

budgets.name: chapters
budgets.spec: §9.2 Chapters (gzip): JS (the KaTeX CSS allowance of 3.4 KB is not measured here)

budgets.name: stageCode
budgets.spec: §9.2 Total 3D payload: stage code and shaders <= 35
